evaluationSplit: last half of source origin dates, fixed before execution
candidateSelection: no selection or automatic promotion; compare all three declared candidates
directionRule: argmax of calibrated class scores, no holdout threshold search
pointForecast: median of the same three-class empirical mixture distribution
range: 10th and 90th quantiles of that mixture, diagnostic only
classShapes: previously realized outcomes only, equal total weight per date within class
warning: Fixed design hypotheses, not established optimum thresholds. This historical evaluation has already been inspected; it is not new prospective evidence. No UI, service forecasts, ranking or trading rules may be changed by this experiment.
